notes.title: Error fixed, READY TO PLAY!
notes.content:
Hello all, 

Thank you for your patience in getting The Beanstalk up and running. The brilliant Steam support crew have worked their arcane skills and set everything right. The Beanstalk can now be downloaded for free! Huzzah!!!

We hope you enjoy the experience, and best of luck finding our Easter eggs!

p.s. We'll be working with the Steam team to make sure that we don't encounter this same error when the time comes to release our next creation: DEMIGOD. More about that later ;)
